    Fixed-weight torsion criteria and generic grains at prescribed missing weights #

    Proves Proposition 2.5(1) (prop:known-baseline) and Proposition 7.6 (prop:grain):

    • fixedWeightTorsionCriteria: for any real weight v ∈ K₀(proj R)_ℝ over any field (even for an E-infinite algebra), v ∈ Σ(R) is equivalent to functorial finiteness of the strict and weak v-semistable torsion and torsion-free classes.
    • exists_generic_grain_kernel_of_missing_weight: at every integral class γ ∉ Σ(R), the endofinite kernel realizing the numerical torsion pair of γ has a generic grain as an indecomposable direct summand.
